title: gateway oscore stores: records cache has no eviction; Err(Full) permanently rejects existing durable contexts past 64
description: Found by 3x codereview of the recipient-store heal (9liz). rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs: GatewayOscoreRecipientStore.records and GatewayOscoreSenderStore cache are Vecs that only grow (recipient capacity gate at ~475-477, sender ~604-606; MAX_GCP_OSCORE_CONTEXTS=64 at gateway.rs:48). After a restart with >64 durable contexts, the first 64 touched fill the cache and every further context - including ones with valid durable sealed state - fails load() with Err(Full) forever, order-dependently; callers drop packets on any error (~1360-1380). The sibling announce store explicitly fixed this class: 'Full is a new-pin admission outcome, never a load outcome' (lichen-node/src/announce_store.rs:300-339, LRU eviction + uncached loads). Additional growth vector: persistent (None,None) load() caches an empty state for any probed context, consuming slots; stale records accumulate across PSK/epoch rotations (ContextId deterministic, so reinstalling same peer reuses its record; rotations mint new ids). Also: Err(Full) is never cached, so each packet for an uncached context repeats the full 2-read + double-schnorr-verify sequence. Fix: adopt the announce store's admission policy (evict LRU on capacity for contexts with durable state; never return Full from load for an already-durable context).
